blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — About 1,800 police officers will be fielded to secure the MassKara Festival here, which kicks off on Oct. 1 and runs until Oct. 18. The festival peaks on Oct. 16 with the Electric MassKara, followed by the arena and street dancing competitions for schools and barangays on Oct. 17 and Oct. 18. Some 80 percent of the Bacolod police force, about 800 officers, will be deployed to secure the festival. They will be joined by a 1,000-person augmentation force requested from the Police Regional Office Negros Island Region, Lt.Col. Lester Leada, Bacolod Police Sub-Site Task Group for Peace […]...
